microsoft-learn-github.title: GitHub Copilot
microsoft-learn-github.description: Candidates for this exam should possess expertise in using GitHub Copilot to improve software development productivity, quality, and security. This includes responsible AI use, prompt engineering, Copilot features across various plans, and privacy safeguards.

microsoft-learn-github.title: GitHub Certified: Agentic AI Developer
microsoft-learn-github.description: You should have subject matter expertise in operating, integrating, supervising, and governing AI agents inside production-grade SDLC workflows and development environments, ensuring reliability, safety, and velocity using GitHub as the system of record and control plane.

microsoft-learn-github.title: GitHub Certified: Agentic AI Business Professional (beta)
microsoft-learn-github.description: As a candidate for this certification, you are in business professional roles including, but not limited to, product manager, program manager, technical project manager, and business analyst.

anthropic-academy.title: Claude 101
anthropic-academy.description: Learn how to use Claude for everyday work tasks, understand core features, and explore resources for more advanced learning on other topics.

anthropic-academy.title: Claude Code 101
anthropic-academy.description: Learn how to use Claude Code effectively in your daily development workflow.

anthropic-academy.title: Claude Platform 101
anthropic-academy.description: This course teaches developers to build on the Claude Platform from the ground up, whether you've made a few API calls or have only used Claude through a chat window.

anthropic-academy.title: Introduction to Claude Cowork
anthropic-academy.description: Learn to work alongside Claude on your real files and projects. This hands-on course covers the Cowork task loop, plugins and skills, file and research workflows, and how to steer multi-step work responsibly — so you're productive in your first week.

anthropic-academy.title: Claude Code in Action
anthropic-academy.description: Run long, hands-off Claude Code sessions you can trust: steer, configure, automate, and verify

anthropic-academy.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
anthropic-academy.description: Learn to collaborate with AI systems effectively, efficiently, ethically, and safely

anthropic-academy.title: Building with the Claude API
anthropic-academy.description: This comprehensive course covers the full spectrum of working with Anthropic models using the Claude API

anthropic-academy.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
anthropic-academy.description: Learn to build Model Context Protocol servers and clients from scratch using Python. Master MCP's three core primitives—tools, resources, and prompts—to connect Claude with external services

anthropic-academy.title: AI Fluency for educators
anthropic-academy.description: This course empowers faculty, instructional designers, and educational leaders to apply AI Fluency into their own teaching practice and institutional strategy.

anthropic-academy.title: AI Fluency for students
anthropic-academy.description: This course empowers students to develop AI Fluency skills that enhance learning, career planning, and academic success through responsible AI collaboration.

anthropic-academy.title: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics
anthropic-academy.description: Discover advanced Model Context Protocol implementation patterns including sampling, notifications, file system access, and transport mechanisms for production MCP server development.

anthropic-academy.title: Claude with Amazon Bedrock
anthropic-academy.description: As part of an accreditation program created for AWS, Anthropic launched a first-of-its-kind training for AWS employees. Here's the full course so you can follow along.

anthropic-academy.title: Claude on Google Cloud
anthropic-academy.description: This comprehensive course covers the full spectrum of working with Anthropic models on Google Cloud.

anthropic-academy.title: Teaching AI Fluency
anthropic-academy.description: This course empowers academic faculty, instructional designers, and others to teach and assess AI Fluency in instructor-led settings.

anthropic-academy.title: AI Fluency for nonprofits
anthropic-academy.description: This course empowers nonprofit professionals to develop AI fluency in order to increase organizational impact and efficiency while staying true to their mission and values.

anthropic-academy.title: Introduction to agent skills
anthropic-academy.description: Learn how to build, configure, and share Skills in Claude Code — reusable markdown instructions that Claude automatically applies to the right tasks at the right time.

anthropic-academy.title: Introduction to subagents
anthropic-academy.description: Learn how to use and create sub-agents in Claude Code to manage context, delegate tasks, and build specialized workflows that keep your main conversation clean and focused.

anthropic-academy.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
anthropic-academy.description: An introductory course about how AI works

anthropic-academy.title: AI Fluency for Small Businesses
anthropic-academy.description: This course empowers small businesses to develop AI fluency in order to increase organizational impact and efficiency while staying true to their mission and values.

anthropic-academy.title: AI Fluency for Builders
anthropic-academy.description: This course empowers builders to develop AI fluency — increasing impact and efficiency while staying true to what it means to own the full arc from problem to shipped solution.

anthropic-academy.title: AI Fluency for Creative Work
anthropic-academy.description: This course empowers creative professionals to develop AI fluency, making intentional, analysis-driven decisions about AI use in their creative practice while protecting what makes their work theirs.

anthropic-academy.title: Deploying Claude Enterprise with Confidence: The five decisions that shape your rollout
anthropic-academy.description: Make the five decisions that shape how Claude works for your organization — Structure & Identity, Access, Governance, Spend, Visibility — and record them in the rollout plan you keep.

cursor-learn.title: AI Foundations
cursor-learn.description: This course will teach you about how to use AI to be more effective as a programmer. It’s not a course to teach about machine learning or how to train your own models, but instead a course focused on developers writing software using AI models and tools.
